body:
## Double Descent Breaks the Simple U-Shape

Very large models sometimes improve again after becoming flexible enough to fit every training example. The old single U-shaped story is incomplete.

This pattern is called double descent. Optimization choices, data shape, and implicit regularization can favor some perfect-fitting solutions over others.

The practical lesson remains empirical: track held-out performance as capacity grows. Parameter count alone does not tell how complex the learned function behaves.
common_mistakes: Choosing a remedy without comparing training and validation behavior.
Assuming model size alone determines effective complexity.
